structured_output.rationale: All four lines denied OA-18 with MOA N111 — the whole claim collided with an already-adjudicated claim, not just the repeat lines. Group OA is never patient liability. Duplicate edits are hard-coded and unappealable; the original claim's disposition governs the money.

root_cause.explanation: 835 denies every line OA-18 'exact duplicate claim/service' with MOA N111, $0 paid, payer claim control 2623576767957 (adjudicated). Claim went as frequency 1 original and matched an earlier adjudicated claim for the same provider/member/DOS/procedures.
